title.value: An Act concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes
title.provenance: AN ACT concerning perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in firefighting foam and supplementing Title 56 of the Revised Statutes. BE IT ENACTED by the Senate and General Assembly of the State of New Jersey:

reference.provenance: INTRODUCED JUNE 2, 2022 Sponsored by: Assemblywoman SHAMA A. HAIDER District 37 (Bergen) Assemblywoman LISA SWAIN District 38 (Bergen and Passaic)

status.provenance: As introduced. This act would prohibit, beginning two years after the bill's effective date, the sale, manufacture, distribution, and use of any class B firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS within the State.

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means substances that include any member of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: Prohibits sale, manufacture, distribution, and use

date.provenance: Beginning two years after the effective date of this act

who.provenance: no person shall use, or shall sell, offer for sale, manufacture, or distribute for sale or use in the State

action.provenance: Prohibits sale, manufacture, distribution, and use of firefighting foam containing intentionally added PFAS

value: for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law, or by a rule or regulation adopted pursuant thereto, including, but not limited to, 14 C.F.R. s.139.317
exceptions.provenance: does not apply to the sale, manufacture, distribution, or use of class B firefighting foam for which the inclusion of PFAS is required by federal law

currently_unavoidable.provenance: The bill does not mention 'currently unavoidable use'

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally added PFAS means PFAS added to a product or one of the product's components to provide a specific characteristic, appearance, or quality or to perform a specific function
